name: Hexhaven
description: The Echoverse academy where Tam trained as a telepath under Jace.

description_citations.text: "Tam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Professor Opal traps Liliana and brings her to the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: The white Liliana overcame her original, trapping her and bringing her back to the Echoverse version of Arcavios.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana kills Professor Opal and reanimates her as a lich.
timeline.quote: Liliana used a swarm of zombie rats to overpower her duplicate and strangled her to death with her bare hands.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five Founder Sphinxes, created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence, found Hexhaven to share magic with the plane's denizens.
timeline.quote: With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Aerid Konstrari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds the original fortress of Hexhaven, keeping it out of reach of mage hunters.
timeline.quote: He used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven, keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters .

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Uldaros Theorix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse Josu Vess never died, so Liliana continues her studies as a healer and her spark never ignites; she becomes Professor Opal.
timeline.quote: In the Echoverse , Josu Vess never died, allowing his sister Liliana to continue her studies in Benalia as a healer.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Professor Opal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: To stabilize the Echoverse the Theorist creates Hexhaven as his inner sanctum.
timeline.quote: Hexhaven was created as his inner sanctum

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Founder Sphinxes select first-year cadets for induction after their trial.
timeline.quote: The Founder Sphinxes select the cadets they wish to enroll

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "Campus life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace creates Tamira as his protege.
timeline.quote: Tamira was designed as Jace's perfect protégé

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Theorist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam decides to stop the Theorist.
timeline.quote: Tam realized that the Theorist had been consumed by his conviction and was no longer capable of reason

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren creates Tam by severing a portion of his own thoughts and giving them form.
timeline.quote: Tam was artificially created by The Theorist, Jace Beleren , when the telepath severed a portion of his own thoughts and gave them form.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam watches Jace excise the doubting parts of his personality, which begins to disturb her.
timeline.quote: Obsessed with his vision of a perfect Multiverse, he began to excise the aspects of his personality that dared to cause him doubt

citation.text: "Tam", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam finds that Jace has become tyrannical and, learning that the Echoverse would destroy the Multiverse, doubts the plan; he sends her to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: The Theorist sensed her doubts and sent her to Innistrad to take measurements and to see the worst horrors that the imperfect Multiverse had to offer.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tam conspires with Vraska to stop Jace and frees Liliana by throwing a raw chicken leg into her cell.
timeline.quote: She conspired with Vraska to stop him, then left for Hexhaven's kitchen.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana reanimates the chicken, escapes and kills her duplicate.
timeline.quote: The necromancer reanimated the chicken, freed herself, and killed her duplicate.

citation.text: "Tam", section "Reckoning in the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Theorist takes up residence in Hexhaven's bell tower, warping the campus into the tower.
timeline.quote: He took up residence in the central bell tower

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The sphinxes found Hexhaven Academy atop the leyline confluence to teach and protect the people of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: Hexhaven Academy was built on top of the large leyline confluence from which the sphinxes had emerged.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds Hexhaven's original fortress to keep the campus from mage hunters.
timeline.quote: The elder sphinx Uldaros Theorix used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress of Hexhaven

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Champions of different schools fail the accension trial in memorable ways.
timeline.quote: Every school has a story of a promising cadet who failed their accension trial.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam returns to Hexhaven after kidnapping Jadzi from Strixhaven, feeling empty rather than victorious.
timeline.quote: On paper, she returned from Strixhaven victorious, her mission complete, her captured oracle in hand.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam sees a vision of Abigale accusing her of lying and leaving.
timeline.quote: You left , signs Abigale. You lied, and you left.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam sees a vision of Lluwen telling her she is just parts.
timeline.quote: "You're just parts ."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam asks Professor Opal about friendship, and Opal tells her not to feel guilty for acts of service to her maker.
timeline.quote: Do not feel guilty for acts of service.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Jadzi's cell and apologizes, and Jadzi tells her she will find what she is looking for.
timeline.quote: "You'll get what you're looking for."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Vess, imprisoned in a hexed cell, taunts Tam about betraying her friends and knowing where Jace puts his shame.
timeline.quote: "I know you, Beleren! I know where you put your shame!"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam telepathically tells the Theorist that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death, and he admits he carved away the part that knew why he made her.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure. I carved the one that knew away.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam climbs to the roof in the night, doubts herself, and reminds herself she is in progress.
timeline.quote: I'm in progress , she reminds herself.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam, lonely in her hexed dormitory, writes a letter of apology and warning to Abigale and burns it.
timeline.quote: The letter ignites quickly, quietly, and burns easily in the waste bin.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: In her cell, Liliana fails to kill a mouse and cannot use her necromancy.
timeline.quote: "Die," she wills, but the intruder merely pauses to clean his whiskers.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Professor Opal, Liliana's double, taunts her about being overwritten and offers to save her; Liliana's heart seizes.
timeline.quote: "Do you wonder what it will be like? Me overwriting you?"

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Opal calls off the heart attack and says Liliana will fade away like cottonwood fluff, and Liliana refuses to give up her pain.
timeline.quote: "My pain is mine ."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Liliana, who asks if Jace is her father or boyfriend, and Tam takes her to see the orrery.
timeline.quote: Tam unlocks the bars, walks to the wood and stone sphere, and holds up a hand.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam shows Liliana the orrery copy and asks what overwriting will mean; Liliana explains it will suffocate the original Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "It won't tear them apart, but layering one Multiverse on another will smother the souls of everyone in the original.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Tam that she has the best parts of Jace and asks her to tell Jace not to keep a woman in a dungeon.
timeline.quote: "From what I can tell, the best parts of himself."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam passes Chandra in the tower and sees Lluwen's vision resentfully remark about half people.
timeline.quote: Why do these half people get to win when the real ones have to die?"

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist goes to Jadzi's cell intending to kill her himself.
timeline.quote: Jadzi, the oracle, awaits with a straight back and a combative glare.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: He dives into Jadzi's mind and drowns in countless possible futures.
timeline.quote: The Theorist's eyes burn bright. He dives into the oracle's mind and crashes into an absolute mess.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi sees his future and the Theorist lowers his hand, failing to kill her.
timeline.quote: The Theorist sees in Jadzi's mind a single image—himself, dropping his hand—and she sees him see it in turn.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi taunts him and he storms out.
timeline.quote: The Theorist turns, embarrassed, furious, and slams the cell door behind him.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The false Liliana heals herself, reveals she will tell the Theorist and runs off.
timeline.quote: "Now, if you'll excuse me, the Theorist needs to know you're here, and uncooperative,"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
timeline.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
timeline.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes they only fought the Theorist, the worst part of Jace.
timeline.quote: "That's not Jace," Vraska concludes with a sick roil of her guts. "It's just what's left."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Tam in a hallway and recognizes who she is.
timeline.quote: "Vraska," she says. "I know your name."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam warns Vraska that the Theorist can only be beaten by a telepath and says the tower is made of his memories; she tells her to rescue Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "It isn't worth it to fight him directly. You need to rescue Jadzi before he can use her."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
timeline.quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace knows he is going to die.
timeline.quote: Jace knows he is going to die.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Vraska she wants her friend Jace back so she can kick his ass, and breaks into tears.
timeline.quote: I want my friend back so I can kick his ass!

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
timeline.quote: "Dad says hi," says her double

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Doubles of Ajani, Garruk and Vraska arrive, and Vraska guides Chandra in a blind fight.
timeline.quote: "It's my double! It takes a few seconds for petrification to charge.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Vraska animates a statue of the Theorist that crushes Vraska and Chandra.
timeline.quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist asks Vraska to give up, but she spits in his face and demands Beleren back, and he throws them into a portal.
timeline.quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: In her dormitory, Tam reflects on what she wants and resolves to betray the worst part of her maker in honor of the best parts.
timeline.quote: I have to betray the worst part of him in honor of the best parts.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam runs from the tower as Hexhaven merges into Strixhaven, believing Jadzi is dead.
timeline.quote: She's too late. Jadzi must be dead.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Hexhaven doppelgangers attack new Strixhaven students while Dellian Fel calmly conjures plants.
timeline.quote: The blank-eyed doppelgängers of Hexhaven flock to these new students

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam realizes the Theorist taught her everything except how to separate the planes once combined, and tries to push against the Echoverse's seam.
timeline.quote: He knows how two planes combined … but not how to separate them once the process begins.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam hears Kirol, uses chance magic to deflect falling cobblestones, and saves them.
timeline.quote: and pulls at the threads of chance that crisscross high above.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Kirol and Tam reunite in a hug; Tam apologizes and explains the overlay.
timeline.quote: Kirol lurches forward, shoving past the throngs of people between them, and envelops Tam in a hug.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam explains her teacher's theorem cannot be reversed while part of him lives; Kirol tells her she will solve it and leaves to find their friends.
timeline.quote: "You're going to solve it," they say with certainty.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam feels small and incomplete as the overlay spreads across the Multiverse and she is swallowed by the crowd.
timeline.quote: In this moment, Tam feels that she is inadequacy.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The spark falls like a meteor and strikes Tam in the chest, filling her with energy and emotion.
timeline.quote: It hits her in the chest, and she gasps.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches out with her mind to Emrakul and asks her to feast on the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Will you feast at my invitation?

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul agrees, promising to devour and to heal.
timeline.quote: I will come to devour and to heal.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam feels new dreams and wants from the spark and realizes the Echoverse is crashing into the original.
timeline.quote: She wants to learn how to ride a horse .

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul engulfs the sky over Hexhaven.
timeline.quote: Emrakul engulfs the sky.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Emrakul opens her mouth and begins devouring the Echoverse, and doubles of planes fade.
timeline.quote: As the mirrored plane shakes and sputters, it begins to fade.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Founder Sphinxes and cadets fight Emrakul as she distinguishes one plane from another and pulls matter into her maw.
timeline.quote: "She is distinguishing one plane from the other!"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Hexhaven is marked as separate from Strixhaven and begins being drawn into the sky.
timeline.quote: Around her, Hexhaven is marked separate from Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace's voice speaks in Tam's mind, telling her she is his fail-safe and she inherits his spark.
timeline.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam is complete, becoming real for the first time and recognizing herself as a clean slate.
timeline.quote: For the first time in her existence, she knows exactly who she is.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam's eyes alight with blue and she planeswalks home to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Tam's eyes alight with blue.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds the first fortress of Hexhaven, raising the campus out of the reach of mage hunters.
timeline.quote: He used his reality-bending magic to build the first fortress of Hexhaven

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace uses the magical energy of Hexhaven Academy to stabilize his creation.
timeline.quote: Jace uses this place of abundant magical energy to stabilize his creation.

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace uses the dystopian school Hexhaven as the inner sanctum that stabilizes the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: This inner sanctum is the dystopian school Hexhaven , the Echoverse's version of Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Mage hunters attack Hexhaven and its mages.
relations.quote: keeping the campus out of reach of the mage hunters, which had grown bolder in their attacks.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

relations.quote: The current headmaster is Liliana Vess , not Taiva .

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: each of which was founded by an Elder Sphinx
